dedupe_keys.name: togo drinking water and small dam inventory on opendata gouv tg 320 water towers 5 770 standpipes 14 071 hand pumps 611 hill reservoirs and 300 dikes and small dams csv with wkt geometry

description: Togo's open data portal opendata.gouv.tg publishes point and line layers of rural and urban water infrastructure from the Geodata Togo field census, under the water and agriculture ministries. Contents: 320 water towers with name, operator (Togolaise des Eaux, village water schemes and others), construction and commissioning year; 5,770 public standpipes with operator; 14,071 human-powered hand pumps (PMH) with locality and operator; 611 hill reservoirs (retenues collinaires) with dam name, type and use; 300 dikes and small dams as lines; plus sub-layers for Togolaise des Eaux towers and standpipes, mini piped schemes and boreholes, water service coverage rates and TdE agencies. Producer: the Togolese government through Geodata Togo. Coverage: all five regions, located to canton and locality. Format and access: CSV files with WKT geometry in WGS84, open download without registration, plus schema files. Licence: other open licence as listed on the portal. Caveats: the autonomous water points (PEA) and the drinking water and irrigation dams layers are private with only their schemas public; many year fields read NSP (unknown); the files date from December 2024 and carry no pipe network. Simulation uses: mapping water supply points for service access and outage impact studies, flood and drought exposure of small dams and reservoirs, and planning emergency water distribution. Related records: the Togo road inventory (data-togo-geodata-national-road-inventory-classified-roads-rural-tracks-drainage) comes from the same census.
